Independent scientific lifecycle review delivered and read back in full:

https://github.com/CartmanFatass/My-paper-code/blob/eaed5cb6cc52422ec9535e559755dd89dd8ea992/docs/research/candidates/degraded_incumbent_shadow_handover/pro_packets/20260914_lifecycle_review/archive/RESPONSE.md

Fixed TASK:
https://github.com/CartmanFatass/My-paper-code/blob/53d7c48d0a5699a9112b241c815a98a47ce36517/docs/research/candidates/degraded_incumbent_shadow_handover/pro_packets/20260914_lifecycle_review/TASK.md

The review preserves B08 WITHIN/REPLACE and the existing retained-A03 arrival-family PARK, while challenging the present decision-value argument for declining receipt bypass. It recommends DM reconsideration of one fresh bypass-versus-REPLACE whole-policy comparison, not an automatic HALF_RETAIN repeat. This is substantive independent review for the DM to answer, not a lifecycle veto, experiment allocation or funding approval.

All thirteen listed sources were read at their specified revisions. The review preserves the -6.5 result, one-pair uncertainty, lower-energy/adverse-event companions, zero ordinary CAS, unresolved source effects and incomplete cost accounting. No seed, card, cap, code change, experiment or lifecycle action was selected or executed by this review.

Verified commit eaed5cb6cc52422ec9535e559755dd89dd8ea992 is one commit above pre-write HEAD 8545df628ffe534155dd7f8927ae65f8765b1535, adding only the authorized RESPONSE.md (53 lines, zero deletions). That parent was confirmed to descend from the authorized base 48ec5480e6c9288cb55d2df1aea61faf4217eb6d.
